title: Restoring SETI budget and closed-door seminar to SETI scientists
place_text: House of Representatives; Jet Propulsion Laboratory

tellings.quote: I went with you know Rusty Schwab and a whole bunch of the schwier and a bunch of the other folks uh and we went around and talked to the Congress people and they put the money back in

plain: In 1977, after Congress cut funding for SETI, the scientific search for signals from alien civilisations, a group lobbied members of the House of Representatives and got the money put back. A guest named Dan Sheehan says he took part, going round to members of Congress with others, including the former astronaut Rusty Schweickart, and he also mentions a congressional researcher named Marcia Smith. The story's title also links this to a closed-door seminar for SETI scientists at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's space research centre. It would mean people inside Washington were quietly backing the search for alien life.
